name: Scandinavian minor kingdoms
alt: Vendel Period and Viking Age Scandinavia

predecessors.name: Norse
predecessors.text: the Norse shape of 490-499 (358 cells), 348 of which lie inside the 500 shape

predecessors.name: Angles
predecessors.text: Angeln, the Anglian homeland in southern Jutland (6 cells, 5 of them inside this row's 500 shape)

successors.name: Kingdom of Germany
successors.text: Schleswig, the Danish border town of Hedeby and its surroundings (20 cells inside this row's 875 shape), conquered by Henry the Fowler in 934

successors.name: Old Kingdom of Norway
successors.text: Norway's petty kingdoms, 1,004 cells in 866, then Hålogaland (Nordland and Troms) in 870 and Rogaland in 872

successors.name: Kingdom of Denmark
successors.text: Jutland and the islands (221 cells) in 936, then Scania, Halland and Blekinge (114 cells) in 960

successors.name: Kingdom of Sweden
successors.text: all the land Sweden takes from this row: the Mälaren lands (136 cells) in 980, Värmland, Dalarna, Örebro, Västergötland and Östergötland (345 cells) in 1000, and the last 252 cells in 1003 (733 cells…

ledger.x: 500: the Scandinavian minor kingdoms begin, as Cliopatria's aggregate of the Scandinavian petty kingdoms.
523: a few cells are added in Denmark and southern Sweden.
793: the shape is redrawn at the start of the Viking Age.
793: 70 interior cells (Hedmark 25, Värmland 13) are dropped in the same redrawing.
804: Denmark's southern boundary is the Eider.
808: Gudfred strikes the Obotrites.
810: the Danish pressure on the Obotrites ends with Gudfred's death.
866: Harald Fairhair begins the conquests that unite Norway.
866: the fighting over the remaining Norwegian petty kingdoms starts with Harald's first conquests.
870: Hålogaland, the north, passes to Harald.
870: 139 cells are added in Sweden (136 in Sweden, 37 in Värmland).
872: Harald wins at Hafrsfjord and the west coast is his.
872: the wars of unification end at Hafrsfjord, after which Harald is king of the whole country.
875: a frontier tidy-up of 10 cells added and 4 dropped.
875: 4 cells (3 in Norway) are dropped in the same frontier tidy-up as the 10 added above.
934: Henry the Fowler conquers Schleswig from the Danes.
936: Gorm the Old becomes king and Denmark leaves the minor kingdoms.
960: Scania and the Swedish south-west pass to the Danes.
980: Cliopatria starts the Kingdom of Sweden on the Mälaren lands.
1000: the Geats and the middle lands join the Kingdom of Sweden.
1002: the last minor kingdoms join the Kingdom of Sweden, whose 1003 shape is 144,672 km2.

wars.name: Gudfred's wars against the Franks and the Obotrites
wars.outcome: A Frankish army reached the Eider in 804, which is Denmark's southern boundary; Gudfred destroyed Reric in 808 and the Slavic lands accepted Danish overlordship until Drożko's return and murder in the rebuilt Reric; Gudfred was murdered in 810 while…

wars.name: Harald Fairhair's wars of unification
wars.outcome: Harald wins the Battle of Hafrsfjord in 872 and becomes king of the whole country; the petty kingdoms of Norway leave the minor kingdoms for the Old Kingdom of Norway.

wars.name: Henry the Fowler's Danish campaign
wars.outcome: Henry the Fowler conquers Schleswig from the Danes in 934; the page gives neither the extent nor the end of German control, and Cliopatria holds Schleswig again in the Danish shape of 936.

wars.name: Battle of Svolder
wars.outcome: Olaf Tryggvason of Norway is attacked by 'the allied fleets' at Svolder; the victors divide Norway, Olof Skötkonung receiving parts of Trøndelag and Bohuslän.

certainty.note: An aggregate of petty kingdoms: 'By 800, some 30 small kingdoms existed in Norway'.
